beats.say: I'm thirsty! Time for a drink!
I'll pour it on my antenna!
Water goes in your mouth, not on your antenna!
Okay! I'll drink it upside down!
Hold your cup the right way up, and take a sip.
Water and milk are the best drinks!
Did you drink some water today?

sources.fact: The best drinks to give children are water and milk; water is a healthy and cheap choice to keep you hydrated
